blocks.text: A second car bomb in two days exploded in Moscow, targeting an exiled Ukrainian political aide, according to Russian media. Meanwhile, Ukraine and Russia exchanged deadly strikes overnight. DW has more.

blocks.text: Here are the latest developments from the Russia's war in Ukraine on Friday, November 13:

Ukraine and Russia exchanged drone attacks overnight

blocks.text: Ukraine and Russia exchange drone attacks overnight

blocks.caption: Russian attacks triggered a fire in the Kyiv hospitalImage: Gleb Garanich/REUTERS

blocks.text: Overnight drone attacks killed several in both Ukraine and Russia.

In the southern Ukrainian city of Odesa, authorities said two people had been killed and five others injured. One person was reportedly injured in an attack on a hospital, according to reports from the capital city of Kyiv.
A Russian attack on Zaporizhzhia in the southeast killed a 17-year-old boy, acting regional governor Mykhailo Semikin said.
Meanwhile, In the Russian city of Volgograd, four people were killed and two others injured, regional government said.
